preconditions.description: The number of elements in permutation p is between 1 and 10^6.
The length of permutation p is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in permutation p is between 1 and n.
All elements in permutation p are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a permutation of length n.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(1 <= return_value[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each element in the output permutation is between 1 and n.
All elements in the output permutation are distinct.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '-1' implies all(return_value[return_value[i] - 1] == p[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If a valid permutation q exists, then q^2 = p.
